prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1155; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you state your full name for the record?
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim file.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was in Conroe, Texas, on the main road near the shopping center. I was trying to move into the right lane because I needed to make a turn coming up.
Q: What did you see before you changed lanes?
A: I checked my mirror and saw the lane looked clear. I put on my signal and started to merge. Then I felt a bump on the driver's side and heard scraping.
Q: Where was the other vehicle when you first noticed it?
A: It was right beside me, a little behind my door. I didn't see it when I checked, and I don't think it was there a second before.
Q: Did you stop after the contact?
A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. The other driver stopped too and we exchanged information. Neither of us was hurt badly at the scene.
Q: Have you had any injuries since the collision?
A: Yes, my lower back has been sore and stiff. When I got out of the car I could barely straighten up. I didn't think much of it at first, but it has gotten worse.
Q: Have you seen a medical provider for the back pain?
A: I went to urgent care that same day and they gave me muscle relaxers and told me to follow up with my doctor. I'm scheduled for physical therapy.
Q: Did you have any prior problems with your back?
A: I had some stiffness years ago after lifting something heavy, but nothing that stopped me from working or driving.
Q: Is there anything else you want to add to your statement?
A: Only that I've been careful about following up on my treatment, and I'm willing to provide the medical records.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
